newsitem.title: INDIA: India's MTNL falls 4.6 pct on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India's MTNL falls 4.6 pct on BSE.

text.p: Shares of telecommunications firm MTNL fell 13 rupees or 4.6 percent to 268.75 on Monday in afternoon trade on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), traders said.

They said news that MTNL was likely to feature in an upcoming list of state-run firms to be divested had pulled the share price lower. The list is due to be released in April, the Economic Times newspaper said.
"Investors will have an opportunity to pick up the stock at a competitive price during the divestment," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
